This Side of Paradise

F. Scott Fitzgerald

F. Scott Fitzgerald’s 
This Side of Paradise
 describes life at Princeton among the glittering, bored, and disillusioned—the post–World War I “lost generation.” Published in 1920, when he was just twenty-three, the novel was an overnight success and shot Fitzgerald to instant stardom as dauphin of the Jazz Age.
